headline: Viral Thread Discovers 'The Month Everyone Collectively Forgot'
subheadline: October 2021 has zero memorable events for 89% of survey respondents
summary: An investigation into collective memory has identified a month that appears to have left no impression on humanity.
content:
A Threadit investigation has identified what users are calling "the forgotten month": October 2021, a period of time that 89% of survey respondents cannot recall anything specific about.

The investigation began when user u/TemporalAnomaly asked: "Does anyone remember anything from October 2021? Like, anything at all?" The post received 12,000 comments, nearly all expressing the same blank.

"I just tried to remember October 2021," wrote one user. "I remember September 2021. I remember November 2021. October is just... static. Like a corrupted file."

A follow-up survey of 8,470 respondents confirmed the phenomenon. When asked to recall specific memories from October 2021, respondents could name zero distinct events. In contrast, surveys about other months produced specific memories in 67-84% of respondents.

"This is genuinely unusual," admitted memory researcher Dr. Amanda Foster. "Months typically have anchoring events—holidays, weather changes, personal milestones. October 2021 has none. It's as if it didn't register."

Attempts to research what happened in October 2021 have proven difficult. News archives from the period exist but feel "weirdly generic." No major cultural moments are recorded. Weather was reportedly "unremarkable." Even users who check their own photos from that month report finding them "oddly forgettable."

"I looked at my camera roll," reported one user. "I have photos from October 2021. I'm in them. But looking at them feels like looking at someone else's memories. They don't connect to anything."

Theories range from "collective trauma response" to "simulation maintenance window" to "that's just what happens sometimes." None have been confirmed.

Dr. Foster offered a measured take: "Either October 2021 was simply unremarkable, or something about it resists being remembered. Both possibilities are concerning in different ways."

At press time, someone had attempted to post their October 2021 memories. The post appeared briefly, then disappeared. No one can remember what it said.
author: Marcus Webb, Internet Culture Correspondent
